acceptance: Native 2D sprite/image import via file dialog (.png, .jpg, .jpeg) and SDL_DROPFILE drag-and-drop into project assets and layer stack.
Customizable bones: create new bone, remove bone (with child reparenting), rename bone (id and display name), reparent bone, and edit rest coordinates.
Preconfigured bone presets: Humanoid (14 joints), Simple Biped (8 joints), Quadruped (11 joints), Prop (2 joints), and Empty/Custom.
Multi-clip animation library in AppState and UI clip switcher in the timeline/toolbar.
Pre-built animation pack (Idle, Walk, Run, Melee Attack, Shield Block) and smooth out-of-the-box functional sample animation on startup.
Automated tests for custom joints, hierarchy validation, rig presets, animation presets, and image import.
Clean build without errors: odin check src, odin test tests, and odin build src -out:bin/chocobones.
Updated canonical documentation in docs/ and synchronized CHANGELOG.md.
constraints: Adhere to Clean Architecture and Odin memory tracking with zero leaks.
Keep exported PNG and existing project file backwards compatibility.
non_goals: 3D skeletal mesh skinning (keep focused on 2D puppet rig while preserving existing 3D viewer).
objective: Implement native 2D image import, customizable bones/rig presets, multi-clip animation library and fluid functional sample animation
title: Dynamic Rigging, Native Asset Import and Animation Library
